name: Ryuuhou
source:
「I am the Red Dragon Maiden! And I will become 『King』of this continent！」

Self-proclaimed Red Dragon Maiden.

She is an energetic girl who wants to be the "King of the Continent" for the mundane reasons of eating good things, wearing good clothes, being extravagant... and being freer than anyone else.

While leaving her job as a constrictive government official to become a bandit chieftain, she encounters [url=https://vndb.org/c136830]Shibasen[/url], who falls from the sky and chooses to stand up for the sake of the world, the people, and herself.

With only the determination of "becoming king", she comes into contact with the dreaded [url=https://vndb.org/c136820]Kouu[/url] as an equal, even becoming sworn sisters with her.

Although her military prowess and planning ability are average, her courage and character, which swallow everything whole, draw many generals to her. She even accepts [url=https://vndb.org/c136830]Shibasen[/url], who conceals his actual name, as a friend.
